name.description: Variable name in GUID-Name format, e.g., 8be4df61-93ca-11d2-aa0d-00e098032b8c-Boot0000 (corresponds to -n/--name)

append.description: Append data to variable specified by --name (corresponds to -a/--append)

datafile.description: File to load or save variable contents from/to (corresponds to -f/--datafile)

export_file.description: File to export variable to (corresponds to -e/--export)

import_file.description: File to import variable from (corresponds to -i/--import)

attributes.description: UEFI attributes as comma-separated flags (e.g., Boot, Runtime, Authenticated); empty string disables flag (corresponds to -A/--attributes)

dmpstore.description: Use DMPSTORE format when exporting (corresponds to -D/--dmpstore)

print_decimal.description: Print variable in decimal format (corresponds to -d/--print-decimal)

write.description: Write to variable specified by --name (corresponds to -w/--write)
